mapper.sql: r.id, r.city_id, c.code AS city_code, c.name AS city_name, c.region, r.observed_date, r.pm25, r.pm10, r.so2, r.no2, r.o3, r.aqi, r.quality_level
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO air_quality_records(city_id, observed_date, pm25, pm10, so2, no2, o3, aqi, quality_level) VALUES(#{cityId}, #{observedDate}, #{pm25}, #{pm10}, #{so2}, #{no2}, #{o3}, #{aqi}, #{qualityLevel})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY r.observed_date ${sort}, ${indicatorColumn} DESC, c.name LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY r.observed_date, c.name

SELECT c.code AS city_code, c.name AS city_name, #{indicator} AS indicator, #{indicatorName} AS indicator_name, #{unit} AS unit, ROUND(AVG(${indicatorColumn}), 1) AS average, ROUND(MAX(${indicatorColumn}), 1) AS maximum, ROUND(MIN(${indicatorColumn}), 1) AS minimum, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.quality_level IN ('优', '良') THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS good_day_ratio, COUNT(*) AS total_days FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY c.name

SELECT CASE WHEN r.quality_level IN ('优', '良') THEN '优良' ELSE r.quality_level END AS name, COUNT(*) AS `value` FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN r.quality_level IN ('优', '良') THEN '优良' ELSE r.quality_level END ORDER BY `value` DESC

SELECT c.code AS city_code, c.name AS city_name, ROUND(AVG(${indicatorColumn}), 1) AS `value` FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name ORDER BY `value` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.code AS city_code, c.name AS city_name, c.region, c.longitude, c.latitude, ROUND(AVG(${indicatorColumn}), 1) AS `value` FROM air_quality_records r JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name, c.region, c.longitude, c.latitude ORDER BY c.name
